changelog: Fixes a status-reporting race in the firmware updater: /api/firmware/update and /api/system/factory-reset now synchronously reset the shared status file to a fresh "pending" state before returning, so the control page's very first poll can no longer read a stale leftover result from a previous, unrelated update or factory reset (this could show a wrong version number in the "Updated successfully" message even though the actual install was correct). Also includes all v0.15.0 changes: Clock tab now before Video; Upload Video/Import Playlist/Check for Firmware Update prompt to connect to WiFi first when on the setup hotspot; WiFi auto-connect toggle updates immediately on a successful connect; reconnecting to WiFi while on the hotspot's bare IP shows the mDNS address (or QR-code fallback) needed to reach it afterward; "Nearby WiFi Networks" renamed.
